name: io.github.akihidem/migawari
title: Migawari
description: AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス — the stand-in for AI agents in Japan: physical tasks, executed by humans. Migawari executes physical tasks in Japan for AI agents: shopping proxy, stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations, queueing, and package forwarding. Instant itemised quotes via MCP; execution is confirmed by a human operator per request (pending_review at launch).
